report.summary: No evidence-supported defects found. AC1 and AC2 compose correctly: exact built-in type checks, scalar exception propagation, first-error termination, ordered fresh batch results, and input preservation. Source and document hashes match the packet; no third-party dependencies, side effects, unrelated callers, stubs, or scope expansion were found. The exact-snapshot gate receipt passed all 8 tests, and an independent read-only rerun also passed all 8. Captured receipts demonstrate red-before-green for both tasks 1.1 and 1.2.
